name: Netherfield District Council

ring.prompt: Welcome to Netherfield District Council. Your call may be recorded. Lines are busy at the moment — please hold.

menu.prompt: For bins and recycling, press one. For housing, press two. For planning, press three. For council tax, including bereavement, press four.
menu.wrongKeyPrompt: That wasn't a valid choice. Please select again from the menu.

holdAnnouncement: You can also report most things on our website. Otherwise, please continue to hold and we'll answer as soon as we can.

clerk.greeting: Council tax team, this is Barbara speaking. I can see you've come through on the bereavement option — I'm sorry for your loss. Can I take the name of the person who's died?

turns.reprompt: Sorry, could you give me that name once more?

turns.say: Thank you. And the date of death?
turns.reprompt: The date again, please — I just want it right on the record.

turns.say: And are you the executor? Your name and relationship, please.
turns.reprompt: Just your name and how you're related, for our records.

documents: death certificate; we may adjust the council tax with a single-person discount or an exemption while the property is empty
outcome.closing: I've updated the council tax record, and any exemption will be applied from the date of death. Your reference is {REF}. You'll see the revised bill in the post.

quirk: Applies the empty-property exemption from the date of death without being asked.
